title: Best GPU for LLM Training
description: Training a large language model from scratch or continuing pre-training needs the highest memory bandwidth and multi-GPU NVLink scaling you can rent.

title: Best GPU for LLM Fine-tuning
description: Fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, full fine-tune) on 7B-70B models is far cheaper than pre-training and runs well on a single 80GB card.

title: Best GPU for ComfyUI & Stable Diffusion
description: Image generation workloads (SDXL, ComfyUI workflows, ControlNet) are shader-bound and VRAM-bound, not bandwidth-bound — consumer cards win on price per image.

title: Best GPU for AI Inference / LLM Serving
description: Serving a model in production is about $/token and concurrency, not raw training FLOPs — right-size the card to the model's quantized VRAM footprint.

title: Best GPU for 3D Rendering
description: Offline rendering (Blender Cycles, Octane, Redshift) benefits from high VRAM and CUDA core counts to fit large scenes and cut render-farm wall-clock time.

title: Best GPU for Video Editing & Encoding
description: 4K/8K timeline scrubbing, color grading and NVENC-accelerated exports care more about decode/encode throughput and VRAM headroom than raw training FLOPs.
